title: Detection and quantification of Candida spp. from subgingival areas
author: Sanja Petrovic
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wdefa3e

steps.title: Clinical periodontal examination
steps.instruction: Perform a full‑mouth examination at six sites per tooth to diagnose chronic periodontitis and locate the deepest periodontal pocket (highest PPD). Record plaque index (Silness‑Löe), bleeding on probing (BOP), periodontal pocket depth (PPD) and clinical attachment loss (CAL). Do not collect any samples on this day to avoid blood contamination.

steps.title: Subgingival sampling
steps.instruction: On the second day, isolate the sampling tooth with cotton rolls; remove supragingival plaque using a curette and sterile gauze; insert two sterile #30 paper points into the pocket/sulcus until mild resistance is felt, keep them for 30 seconds and discard any points contaminated with blood; place the paper points into 1 mL of Sabouraud dextrose broth; additionally, use a sterile curette to collect the complete subgingival biofilm and inoculate it into a separate sterile plastic tube containing 1 mL of Sabouraud dextrose broth.

substeps.instruction: Isolate the target tooth with cotton rolls.
Remove supragingival plaque with a curette and sterile gauze.
Insert two sterile #30 paper points into the pocket/sulcus until mild resistance, leave for 30 seconds, discard blood‑contaminated points.
Transfer paper points into 1 mL Sabouraud dextrose broth.
Collect the entire subgingival biofilm with a sterile curette and inoculate into a separate sterile tube with 1 mL Sabouraud dextrose broth.

steps.title: Microbiological plating
steps.instruction: Vortex each broth sample for 60 seconds; then using a sterile plastic micropipette, streak 20 µL of the suspended broth onto Sabouraud dextrose agar (SDA) and onto ChromAgar plates.

substeps.instruction: Streak 20 µL of the suspension onto SDA.
Streak 20 µL of the suspension onto ChromAgar.

steps.title: CFU counting and calculation
steps.instruction: On the fourth day, count the colonies on each plate to obtain CFU per sample and multiply the counted number by 50 to express the result as CFU/mL.

substeps.instruction: Multiply the count by 50 to obtain CFU/mL.
